polish_items.title: Add Replay Tutorial button to help panel
polish_items.finding: There is no way to replay the interactive tutorial without clearing localStorage. The help panel covers mechanics but is not the same experience as the guided 6-step tutorial.
polish_items.action_required: Add a 'Replay Tutorial' button at the bottom of the help panel that sets tutorialComplete = false and calls showTutorial(). Close the help panel first.

polish_items.title: Match tutorial input style to game input
polish_items.finding: The practice encounter in tutorial step 3 uses a <textarea> element, while the main game uses an <input> element. This visual inconsistency may confuse players.
polish_items.action_required: Either change the tutorial practice to use <input> matching the game, or change both to <textarea> for consistency. Since multi-sentence answers benefit from textarea, prefer changing the main game input to textarea.

polish_items.title: Scaffold the first real encounter after tutorial
polish_items.finding: After the tutorial completes and the player enters a region for the first time, there is no bridge between tutorial guidance and real gameplay.
polish_items.action_required: When the player enters The Workshop for the very first time (visitedRegions is empty), add a brief guided annotation to the first encounter: 'This is a real encounter now. Apply what you learned in the tutorial. Type your answer in the text box below.' Show this once only.

polish_items.title: Tutorial completion analytics
polish_items.finding: No tracking of which tutorial step players skip at (if they skip) or whether they complete the practice encounter.
polish_items.action_required: Add tutorialStepReached and tutorialPracticeCompleted to state. Save these in localStorage. Display in mastery progress screen.
